mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 88 degrees down at Fireman's Park under a full moon phase.

We have a busy day! Today you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch the free Concerts in the Park. Also, don't miss Hop Haus Trivia happening today.
